# LifeCOMPILERS

> LifeCOMPILERS is a custom software development studio founded in 2020 in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, India. We build web, mobile, and desktop applications with React, Next.js, and modern stacks for startups and growing businesses worldwide.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://lifecompilers.com/#service-web): Production web applications built with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Server-rendered, fast, accessible, ready to scale from MVP to thousands of users.
- [Mobile App Development](https://lifecompilers.com/#service-mobile): Android and iOS apps built with React Native or native frameworks, shipped to the Play Store and App Store in 8 to 14 weeks.
- [Desktop App Development](https://lifecompilers.com/#service-desktop): Cross-platform desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux built with Electron or Tauri, with auto-updates and code signing.

## How we work

- Two-week sprints with weekly client demos
- Clients own all source code and infrastructure from day one — no vendor lock-in
- Default stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js or Python, PostgreSQL or MongoDB
